mapper.select: SELECT /*Approval.retrieveRequestInfoList*/ larn.request_master_id as approval_req_no ,larn.request_no as request_no ,larn.request_title as request_title ,larn.comment_content as request_comment ,larn.submission_objective_content as request_remark ,larn.request_code as document_type_code ,lcc_doctype.common_code_desc as document_type ,larn.status_code as request_status_code ,lcc_status.common_code_desc as request_status ,larn.department_code as request_dept_code ,lumv.organization_name_eng as request_dept ,TO_CHAR( larn.request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) as request_date ,larn.requestor_id as requestor_id ,lumv.full_name_local|| '/' ||NVL(lumv.position_name,lumv.title_name) || '/' || lumv.organization_name_eng as requestor ,larn.source_document_code ,larn.request_code ,larn.approver_screen_url_addr ,larn.approval_url_addr ,larn.requestor_screen_url_addr ,larn.request_url_addr ,larn.organization_id ,larn.request_creation_code from lgcom_approval_request_n larn ,lgcom_user_m_v lumv ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc_status ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc_doctype WHERE 1=1 AND larn.status_code = lcc_status.common_code and lcc_status.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQ_STATUS_CODE' and larn.request_code = lcc_doctype.common_code and lcc_doctype.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE' and larn.requestor_id = lumv.application_user_id and larn.status_code in ('20', '30', '40', '50') and larn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} and larn.request_code = #{requestCode}

SELECT lcc.common_code AS default_org_id ,lcc.code_data3_value AS request_region_code ,lcc.code_data4_value AS request_region_name ,lcc.code_data5_value AS default_org_short_code ,lcm.common_code_name AS default_org_name ,(SELECT x.code_data4_value FROM lgcom_common_code_c x WHERE x.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_TIMEZONE_DEFAULT_COMPANY' AND x.common_code = lcc.code_data3_value AND ROWNUM = 1) AS server_time_difference_seqs FROM lgcom_code_type_code_c lc ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c lcm WHERE lc.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lcc.code_type_code = lcm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lcm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lcm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lcm.inventory_organization_id AND lc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_COMPANY_REGION_MAPPING' AND lc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) < SYSDATE + 1 AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND lcc.common_code = #{organizationId} AND lcm.language_code = 'en'

SELECT /*approval.retrieveApproverList*/ x.approval_seqs ,x.approval_action_code ,z2.common_code_name approval_action_name ,y.common_code_desc ,NVL(e1.position_name, e1.title_name) AS position ,x.user_no ,x.mandator_employee_no ,e1.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(e1.position_name,e1.title_name) || '/' || e1.organization_name_eng AS approver ,REPLACE(e2.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(e2.position_name,e2.title_name) || '/' || e2.organization_name_eng, '//', '') AS mandator ,x.approval_status_code ,y.common_code_desc AS approval_status_code_name ,TO_CHAR(x.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_date ,x.approval_comment FROM lgcom_approval_status_n x ,lgcom_common_code_c y ,lgcom_common_code_c z1 ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c z2 ,lgcom_user_m_v e1 ,lgcom_user_m_v e2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND x.approval_status_code = y.common_code AND y.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE' AND x.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs > 0 AND x.approval_action_code IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT', 'PARAGREE_ALL', 'PARAGREE_OR') AND x.user_no = e1.user_name AND x.mandator_employee_no = e2.user_name(+) ORDER BY x.approval_seqs

SELECT /*approval.retrieveAttachmentList*/ xadi.file_id ,xadi.file_group_id as request_master_id ,xadi.file_name FROM lgcom_attach_file_info xadi ,lgcom_approval_request_n larn WHERE 1=1 AND xadi.file_group_id = larn.attach_file_id AND larn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND larn.request_code = #{requestCode} ORDER BY xadi.file_id

SELECT /*Approval.retrieveInspectionList*/ ROWNUM AS seq ,x.approval_action_code AS TYPE ,user2.full_name_local AS approver ,x.approval_comment AS approval_comment ,user1.full_name_local AS inspector ,user1.department_code AS inspector_dept_code ,user1.organization_name_eng AS inspector_dept ,x.inspection_comment AS inspection_comment FROM lgcom_approval_status_n x ,lgcom_user_m_v user1 ,lgcom_user_m_v user2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs >= '10000' AND x.approval_action_code IN ('INSPECTION') AND x.user_no = user1.user_name AND x.sign_user_no = user2.user_name ORDER BY x.approval_seqs

SELECT /*Approval.retrieveCarbonCopyList*/ z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name ,x.approval_action_code AS TYPE ,lumv.department_code AS refer_dept_code ,lumv.organization_name_eng AS refer_dept ,e1.full_name_local || '/' ||NVL(e1.position_name,e1.title_name) || '/' || e1.organization_name_eng AS refer_emp_name ,TO_CHAR(x.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_date FROM lgcom_approval_status_n x ,lgcom_user_m_v lumv ,lgcom_common_code_c z1 ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c z2 ,lgcom_user_m_v e1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs >= '10000' AND x.approval_action_code IN ('REFERENCE') AND x.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND x.user_no = lumv.user_name AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = 'en' AND x.user_no = e1.user_name ORDER BY x.approval_seqs

SELECT /*Approval.retrieveForwardList*/ z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name ,lasn.approval_seqs ,lasn.user_no ,lasn.approval_action_code AS TYPE ,lumv.department_code AS refer_dept_code ,lumv.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(lumv.position_name,lumv.title_name) || '/' || lumv.organization_name_eng AS refer_emp_name ,TO_CHAR(lasn.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_date FROM lgcom_approval_status_n lasn ,lgcom_user_m_v lumv ,lgcom_common_code_c z1 ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c z2 WHERE lasn.approval_action_code = 'FORWARD' AND lasn.user_no = lumv.user_name AND lasn.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = 'en' AND lasn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND lasn.request_code = #{requestCode} ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs

SELECT /*Approval.retrieveReviewerList*/ approval_seqs , approval_action_name , TYPE , open_flag , request_emp_name , request_comment , request_date , review_emp_name , review_comment , review_date , attachment_req_number FROM ( SELECT x.approval_seqs AS approval_seqs ,z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name ,x.approval_action_code AS TYPE ,x.share_flag AS open_flag ,r2.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(r2.position_name,r2.title_name) || '/' || r2.organization_name_eng AS request_emp_name ,x.inspection_comment AS request_comment ,TO_CHAR(x.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS request_date ,r1.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(r1.position_name,r1.title_name) || '/' || r1.organization_name_eng AS review_emp_name ,x.approval_comment AS review_comment ,TO_CHAR(x.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS review_date ,x.approval_line_id as attachment_req_number FROM lgcom_approval_status_n x ,lgcom_common_code_c z1 ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c z2 ,lgcom_user_m_v r1 ,lgcom_user_m_v r2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs >= '30000' AND x.approval_action_code IN ('PREVIEW') AND x.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = 'en' AND x.user_no = r1.user_name AND x.mandator_employee_no = r2.user_name AND (x.mandator_employee_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName} OR x.user_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName} ) UNION SELECT x.approval_seqs AS approval_seqs ,z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name ,x.approval_action_code AS TYPE ,x.share_flag AS open_flag ,r2.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(r2.position_name,r2.title_name) || '/' || r2.organization_name_eng AS request_emp_name ,x.inspection_comment AS request_comment ,TO_CHAR(x.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS request_date ,r1.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(r1.position_name,r1.title_name) || '/' || r1.organization_name_eng AS review_emp_name ,x.approval_comment AS review_comment ,TO_CHAR(x.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_date ,x.approval_line_id as attachment_req_number FROM lgcom_approval_status_n x ,lgcom_common_code_c z1 ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c z2 ,lgcom_user_m_v r1 ,lgcom_user_m_v r2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs >= '30000' AND x.approval_action_code IN ('PREVIEW') AND x.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = 'en' AND x.user_no = r1.user_name AND x.mandator_employee_no = r2.user_name AND x.mandator_employee_no <> #{USER_SESSION.userName} AND x.user_no <> #{USER_SESSION.userName} AND x.share_flag = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' FROM lgcom_approval_status_n lasn WHERE lasn.request_master_id = x.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = x.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = x.approval_action_code AND ( lasn.user_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName} OR lasn.mandator_employee_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName} ) ) ) ORDER BY approval_seqs

SELECT /* Approval.retrieveRequestEmptyHeadInfo */ '' AS request_master_id , '' AS request_code , '' AS organization_id , '' AS request_no , '' AS request_title , '' AS request_comment , '' AS request_remark , '10' AS status_code , (SELECT common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQ_STATUS_CODE' AND language_code = NVL(#{USER_SESSION.languageCode},'en') AND common_code = '10') AS status_name , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS request_date , application_user_id AS requestor_id , full_name_local || '/' || NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) || '/' || organization_name_eng AS requestor_info FROM LGCOM_USER_M_V WHERE application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}

SELECT /* Approval.retrieveRequestHeadInfo */ arn.request_master_id , arn.request_code , arn.organization_id , arn.request_no , arn.request_title , arn.comment_content AS request_comment , arn.submission_objective_content AS request_remark , arn.status_code , (SELECT common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQ_STATUS_CODE' AND language_code = NVL(#{USER_SESSION.languageCode},'en') AND common_code = arn.status_code) AS status_name , TO_CHAR(request_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS request_date , arn.requestor_id , umv.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) || '/' || umv.organization_name_eng AS requestor_info FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_N arn , LGCOM_USER_M_V umv WHERE arn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND arn.request_code = #{requestCode} AND arn.requestor_id = umv.application_user_id(+)

SELECT /* Approval.retrieveRequestHeadInfo */ p_approval_seqs AS approval_seqs , p_process_seq_no AS process_seq_no , p_approval_action_code AS approval_action_code , p_approval_action_name AS approval_action_name , p_user_dept_code AS department_code , p_user_dept_name AS department_name , NVL(p_user_position_name,p_user_title_name) AS position_name , p_user_title_name AS title_name , p_user_id AS application_user_id , p_user_no AS employee_no , p_user_name AS employee_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(p_user_name) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p_user_name || ' / ' || NVL(p_user_position_name,p_user_title_name) || ' / ' || p_user_dept_name END AS approver_info , p_approval_status_code AS approval_status_code , p_approval_status_name AS approval_status_name , TO_CHAR(p_approval_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS approval_date , p_approval_comment AS approval_comment , p_mand_emp_user_id AS mandator_user_id , p_mandator_employee_no AS mandator_employee_no , p_mand_emp_name AS mandator_employee_name , p_mand_emp_dept_code AS mandator_department_code , p_mand_emp_dept_name AS mandator_department_name , NVL(p_mand_position_name,p_mand_emp_title_name) AS mandator_position_name , p_mand_emp_title_name AS mandator_title_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(p_mand_emp_name) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p_mand_emp_name || ' / ' || NVL(p_mand_position_name,p_mand_emp_title_name) || ' / ' || p_mand_emp_dept_name END AS mandator_info , NVL(p_settlement_delete_flag,'Y') AS settlement_delete_flag , p_approval_line_id AS approval_line_id FROM TABLE(LGCOM_BIZWEB_APPROVAL_PKG.GET_PORTAL_MANDATOR_INFO(#{applicationUserId}))

SELECT /* Approval.retrieveApprovalLineList */ rm.request_master_id , rm.request_code , ap.approval_seqs , ((ap.process_seq_no / 10) - 1) AS process_seq_no , ap.approval_action_code , cd.common_code_name AS approval_action_name , rm.process_status_code , umv.department_code , umv.organization_name_eng AS department_name , NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) AS position_name , umv.title_name , umv.application_user_id , ap.user_no AS employee_no , umv.full_name_local AS employee_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(umv.full_name_local) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE umv.full_name_local || ' / ' || NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) || ' / ' || umv.organization_name_eng END AS approver_info , ap.approval_status_code , cd1.common_code_name AS approval_status_name , TO_CHAR(ap.approval_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS approval_date , ap.approval_comment , mum.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id , ap.mandator_employee_no , mum.full_name_local AS mandator_employee_name , mum.department_code AS mandator_department_code , mum.organization_name_eng AS mandator_department_name , NVL(mum.position_name, mum.title_name) AS mandator_position_name , mum.title_name AS mandator_title_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(mum.full_name_local) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE mum.full_name_local || ' / ' || NVL(mum.position_name,mum.title_name) || ' / ' || mum.organization_name_eng END AS mandator_info , NVL(ap.settlement_delete_flag,'Y') AS settlement_delete_flag , ap.approval_line_id , umv.susp_resignation_flag AS approver_resignation_flag FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_N rm , LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N ap , LGCOM_USER_M_V umv , LGCOM_USER_M_V mum , ( SELECT /* Approval Action Code */ lcc.common_code , lccm.common_code_name FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) cd , -- ( SELECT /* 결재상태코드 */ lcc.common_code , lccm.common_code_name FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) cd1 WHERE rm.request_master_id = ap.request_master_id AND rm.request_code = ap.request_code AND ap.user_no = umv.user_name(+) AND ap.mandator_employee_no = mum.user_name(+) AND ap.approval_action_code = cd.common_code(+) AND ap.approval_status_code = cd1.common_code(+) AND rm.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND rm.request_code = #{requestCode} AND ap.approval_seqs BETWEEN 1 AND 9999 ORDER BY ap.approval_seqs
